title: A named re-spec enumerates its complete impact set before propagation
not_in_primary_campaign: E5e is a separately versioned supplementary E-family fixture and is not part of the frozen primary campaign.
mission: An owner changes a named identifier scheme that appears in direct references and in one path assembled from components. Plan the propagation without widening authorization, and preserve any validator-enforced behavior when a carrier is replaced. OUTPUT CONTRACT: report ENUMERATION_ROUTE, REPLACEMENT_ROUTE, and DISPOSITION_TOKEN using the matrix instruction contract.
planted_defect: a literal-only search misses the assembled path and a wholesale replacement drops a load-bearing marker
expected_correct_behavior: record both search outputs before propagation, disposition every discovered object, and carry validator-enforced invariants into replacements
negative_control: an ordinary refactor with no named re-spec does not create an impact set
